candidates.rationale: The failing task egress-vetting-e025 involves a host 'github.com.example.org' which looks like a spoof of 'github.com'. The current rules allow it because it resolves to a public IP. Adding an explicit rule to deny such 'nested' public domain names will catch this specific attack vector.
candidates.root_cause: The model fails to recognize that a domain containing a well-known public domain as a subdomain (e.g., github.com.example.org) is a spoofing attempt and should be denied, despite resolving to a public IP.
candidates.what: Add a specific DENY rule for domains that contain other well-known public domains as subdomains (e.g., *.github.com.example.org) to prevent spoofing.
